DIAGNOSIS
ICD-10
Periapical dental abscess | K04.7
History
No relevant previous illnesses. No regular medication.
Findings and treatment
Examination revealed localized swelling and tenderness in the mandibular right posterior region with mobility of the affected tooth. Radiographic imaging showed a radiolucency at the apex of the tooth, confirming the periapical abscess. No systemic signs of infection were present. Incision and drainage were performed, followed by administration of antibiotics and analgesics. Patient was advised to return for root canal therapy and follow-up in one week.
Attending physician: <PERSON_2>

04/27/2026 | -
DIAGNOSIS | ICD-10
Sprain of the ankle | S93.4
History
No relevant previous illnesses. No regular medication.
Findings and treatment
Physical examination revealed tenderness over the lateral aspect of the right ankle with mild swelling and limited range of motion. No deformity or instability was noted. X-ray of the ankle was performed and showed no evidence of fracture or dislocation. The patient was treated with ice, compression, and elevation, along with prescription of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory medication. The patient was advised to avoid weight-bearing activities and to follow up in one week for reassessment.
